title: Teddy Hill, Russell's Chicago recruits and the Nest rhythm section
summary: Teddy Hill joined early; Russell hired Foster, Barbarin and Simeon from Oliver's Chicago band; Will Johnson and Bass Moore were already around the Nest.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, Teddy Hill came into the band, then, fairly early.
Well, he came in when Russell was forming his own band. I mean, he came in as one of them other ones that Russell was hiring every now and then.
Well, Russell... Are you now getting to the Saratoga Club?
Well, we haven't got there yet.
See, Russell had these ideas ih his head about getting this band together and getting these men from Chicago, the ones from King Oliver's band. And he got Pops Foster, Paul Barbarin and Simeon.
Now, where did Will Johnson come from, the banjo-guitar
Well, he was already in the band at the Nest.
He was already at the Nest.
He was there. He was part of George Howard's band. He was a guitar player.
I see. And what about Bass Moore on tuba? Was he there also?

Well, he was there when we made some records. He worked at the Nest. He worked there quite a while at the Nest, when we made them records, and I told you that was Freddy Jenkins on one of the records playing...
